([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/html/2304.06470v5?utm_source=openai))

2. **A temperature of something minimizes randomness during code generation, ensuring code validity and reducing runtime errors.**

   The article "An Empirical Study of the Non-Determinism of ChatGPT in Code Generation" explains that setting the temperature parameter to 0 during code generation makes the output more focused and deterministic, thereby reducing randomness and potentially decreasing runtime errors. ([dl.acm.org](https://dl.acm.org/doi/full/10.1145/3697010?utm_source=openai))

3. **Sampling something when generating variable names causes the entire code snippet to fail execution.**

   The same study notes that non-determinism in code generation, such as varying variable names due to sampling, can lead to execution failures, highlighting the importance of deterministic outputs for code validity. ([dl.acm.org](https://dl.acm.org/doi/full/10.1145/3697010?utm_source=openai))

However, the following sources cover parts of the requested information:

- **Early architectures largely ignore sequential signals**: The article "A Survey on the Evolution of Stream Processing Systems" discusses how early streaming systems often assumed input streams were ordered and discarded late data, effectively ignoring out-of-order sequential signals. ([link.springer.com](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s00778-023-00819-8?utm_source=openai))

- **In production, sequence data are processed with side information**: The article "Sequence learning: A paradigm shift for personalized ads recommendations" explains how Meta's recommendation systems process event sequences enriched with side information, such as multimodal content embeddings, to better understand user preferences. ([engineering.fb.com](https://engineering.fb.com/2024/11/19/data-infrastructure/sequence-learning-personalized-ads-recommendations/?utm_source=openai))

- **Short video platforms have surged in popularity in recent years**: The article "Understanding the Digital and AI Transformation" mentions the extreme levels of data velocity in services like YouTube and Snapchat, indicating their significant growth and popularity. ([scribd.com](https://www.scribd.com/document/858078204/Understanding-the-Digital-and-AI-Transformation?utm_source=openai))
